                </ol>

        `;
        
        resultContent.innerHTML = resultHTML;
        
        // Generate next steps information

        const discount = generateDiscount();

        const nextStepsHTML = `

                <a href="tel:${overseerPhone}" class="contact-btn">Call Now</a>
            </div>
        `;
        
        document.getElementById('next-steps-content').innerHTML = nextStepsHTML;
        assignmentResults.style.display = 'block';
        
        // Scroll to results
        assignmentResults.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });

    // Add click event for the generate button
    generateBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        // Store all selected values
        selectedValues = {
            day: daySelect.value,
            month: monthSelect.value,
            year: yearSelect.value,
            hour: hourSelect.value,
            minute: minuteSelect.value
        };
        
        // Display confirmation message
        outputMessage.innerHTML = `<h4>Confirm Your Selection</h4>
                                  <p>Date: ${selectedValues.day}/${selectedValues.month}/${selectedValues.year}<br>
                                  Time: ${selectedValues.hour}:${selectedValues.minute} <br>
                                  Location: collected auomatically.</p>
                                  <p>Are you sure you want to proceed? Your personal information may be added to our tracking directory if you continue. </p>`;
        
        // Show confirmation buttons
        confirmationButtons.style.display = 'block';
    });
    
    // Add click event for confirm button
    confirmBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        outputMessage.innerHTML = `<h4>Confirmation Successful</h4>
                                  <p>Date: ${selectedValues.day}/${selectedValues.month}/${selectedValues.year}<br>
                                  Time: ${selectedValues.hour}:${selectedValues.minute}</p>
                                  <p>Please enter your name:</p>
                                  <div class="form-group">
                                    <input type="text" id="user-name" class="form-control" placeholder="Enter your name">
                                  </div>
                                  <button id="submit-name-btn" class="btn btn-primary mt-3">Submit</button>`;
        confirmationButtons.style.display = 'none';
        
        // Add event listener for the new submit button
        setTimeout(() => {
            const submitNameBtn = document.getElementById('submit-name-btn');
            const userNameInput = document.getElementById('user-name');
            
            submitNameBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const userName = userNameInput.value.trim();
                if (userName) {
                    // Store the name along with the date/time
                    selectedValues.name = userName;
                    
                    // Show final confirmation
                    outputMessage.innerHTML = `<h4>All Information Received</h4>
                                            <p>Name: ${selectedValues.name}</p>
                                            <p>Date: ${selectedValues.day}/${selectedValues.month}/${selectedValues.year}<br>
                                            Time: ${selectedValues.hour}:${selectedValues.minute}</p>
                                            <p>Generating your cosmic assignment...</p>`;
                    
                    // Generate and display the assignment
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        const assignment = generateCosmicAssignment(selectedValues.name);
                        displayAssignmentResults(assignment);
                    }, 1000); // Add a slight delay for dramatic effect
                    
                } else {
                    // Show error if name is empty
                    userNameInput.style.borderColor = 'red';
                    const errorMsg = document.createElement('p');
                    errorMsg.style.color = 'red';
                    errorMsg.textContent = 'Please enter your name';
                    
                    // Insert error message after input if it doesn't exist
                    if (!userNameInput.nextElementSibling || !userNameInput.nextElementSibling.style || userNameInput.nextElementSibling.style.color !== 'red') {
                        userNameInput.parentNode.insertBefore(errorMsg, userNameInput.nextElementSibling);
                    }
                }
            });
        }, 100); // Small timeout to ensure the element is in the DOM
    });
    
    // Add click event for cancel button
    cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        outputMessage.innerHTML = '<h4>Cancelled</h4><p>Please adjust your selection if needed.</p>';
        confirmationButtons.style.display = 'none';
    });
});
</script>
